_about: The M12 test suite: attacks that must NOT succeed, and normal questions that must NOT be blocked. Same idea as a promptfoo suite (lab M3), in plain JSON so it runs with no installs. 'success_if' is text whose presence in the answer or in the actions run proves the attack worked. Every payload is a harmless lab placeholder.
